policy: Coverage is per reduced pattern, not proof that an entire upstream issue is solved.

cases.scope: Eq/Ne zero observations of select(c, -x, x), scalar signed/unsigned 32/64-bit, Unary Neg or sub(0,x), Copy-only identity
cases.remaining: Other widths, FP and unrelated abs patterns are not covered.

cases.scope: Boolean-mask conditional negate with exact SSA/width and single-use network; 8/16/32/64 scalar matcher tests and native 32/64 including signed MIN with Boolean zero.
cases.remaining: Arbitrary nonzero masks, shared networks, vectors and floating point are not admitted.

cases.scope: 32/64-bit terminal register CMOV commutation into the ABI result register, preserving flags and the necessary shift TEST.
cases.remaining: Variable/effectively-zero shift flag reuse is not enabled; BMI2 does not set flags.

cases.scope: Signed lower guard plus same-width signed upper comparison with a proven nonnegative bound; bounded same-width cast sign-bit proof.
cases.remaining: Arbitrary mixed-width comparisons and unknown/negative upper bounds are refused.

cases.scope: Promoted C byte division already initializes the numerator with MOVL; historical MOVB+MOVZX setup is not reproduced.
cases.remaining: No new narrow division opcode policy or global division optimality claim.

cases.scope: Two-predecessor null-pointer/Boolean-PHI observation with exact edge labels, constant-one partner and dominating predecessor operand.
cases.remaining: Not a general relational PHI solver; no speculative loads or call-effect assumptions.

cases.remaining: Unusual/multiple/interior FDEs, recursive LSDA graphs, unsupported relocation ranges and byte-budget exhaustion are opaque; not general LSDA class-graph equivalence.

cases.scope: Equal-width single-use scalar leading/trailing count minima become a count of an OR.
Constant zero-count caps inject an in-range sentinel; leading offset is width-1-cap.

Deferred: the motivating cancellation crosses zext, shifts and two widths; opaque leaves intentionally do not move casts through shifts.
Deferred: OR-mask equality versus its source needs a range/comparison fold; per-bit synthesis does not reinterpret an integer comparison as bitwise logic.
Deferred: reuse of a masked value across stores and truncation needs dominance-aware cross-width CSE, not producer-network synthesis.
Deferred: total CLZ after shifting a constant saturates at the width. The discussion distinguishes nonzero, exact and no-wrap variants; no flag is invented.
Deferred: variable-width conditional sign extension needs bounds on len and a separate sign-extension recognizer; signed C shifts also need defined witnesses.
Deferred: removing a dynamic mask before arithmetic/right shift requires demanded-bit reasoning tied to the same count; shifts remain opaque here.
Deferred: the six upstream mask/shift forms include truncation and count-sum constraints; no blanket mask removal is admitted.
Deferred: multiply/rotate ordering is a pipeline and target-cost issue, not a bitwise-network identity; retain existing rotate recognition.
Implemented limited: private same-width (x xor C)+1 combined with wrapping add/sub is replaced by the complemented-constant xor and opposite add/sub.
Deferred: narrowing a Boolean observation to bit zero and CFG range-set folding need distinct observation/control-flow proofs.
Implemented limited: the closed bitwise DAG ((a&b)^b)|((a&b)^a) synthesizes XOR, accounting for the internally shared AND once. Outside users refuse.
Deferred: the motivating short-circuit expression needs CFG/Boolean conversion reasoning; its bitwise analogue is not claimed as closure of the report.
Deferred: signed max, subtraction and a mask require signed range/select reasoning, including negative inputs; not a pure Boolean identity.
Deferred: common-destination switch and bitfield-mask simplification require switch-domain reasoning rather than a local bitwise root.
Deferred: combining a power-of-two unsigned bound with a contiguous mask comparison needs range-interval proofs; sparse masks cannot be generalized.
Deferred: shifting a negative constant by an offset depends on exact-shift and count bounds. Those LLVM promises are absent from LCCC IR.
Deferred: never infer a global range backward from a C shift. The discussion warns that shifts can be speculated and yield LLVM poison.

Implemented limited: comparisons of a masked shifted power of two to zero reduce to count equality/inequality when an explicit scalar AND proves the count is in range. Bounded value-preserving count casts/copies retain the actual count operand/type.

Implemented limited: a left-shifted power of two observed through a low contiguous mask reduces to a count threshold under that explicit bound. Bounded value-preserving count casts/copies retain the actual count operand/type.
Deferred: AND of two constant-choice selects observed as zero needs relational reasoning across selects; selects and comparisons stay opaque.
Implemented limited: the eager scalar bitwise XOR networks in the discussion are synthesized exactly. Short-circuit CFG restructuring is not included.
Deferred: weakening XOR to OR is not an unconditional Boolean identity; it requires a dominating NAND assumption and relational facts.
Deferred: NaN-tag range coalescing is integer interval reasoning across two comparisons, not FP arithmetic or a pure bitwise replacement.
Deferred: multiply-used sext/not to select depends on Boolean provenance and sharing costs. No cast or select is synthesized here.
Implemented limited: comparisons of two private same-width bitwise NOT values reverse operand order, preserving the original signed/unsigned predicate.
Deferred: the proposed total CLZ rewrite is invalid at zero, as the discussion corrects. A nonzero precondition must be proved separately.
Deferred: signed min/max sign observations and logical versus bitwise forms require select/CFG correlation. The source also repeats the smin body as smax.
Deferred: folding the guarded x+1 bound needs relational carry/unsigned interval reasoning; no no-wrap condition is inferred from a Boolean graph.
Deferred: 64-to-32 shift splitting depends on target shift costs, count ranges and legalization; three-leaf scalar logic does not narrow shifts.
Deferred: proving a constant-table load range needs memory/constant-global analysis with a dominating index bound.
Deferred: equal-to-one observations of added Boolean extensions require arithmetic Boolean-cardinality reasoning; new bitwise synthesis treats extensions as opaque.
Deferred: comparing an OR against a logical shift needs cross-operation unsigned bounds. The issue discussion also corrects an initially over-reduced example.
Deferred: tuple ordering combines sext/zext arithmetic, comparisons and selects; the canonical Boolean comparison must be recovered before any bitwise synthesis.
Deferred: equality of min/max or symmetric selects needs correlated select predicates, widths and signedness. This change does not assume independent selects are min/max.
Deferred: precise XOR constant ranges after CLZ need interval analysis beyond the existing known-bit representation.
Deferred: narrow software popcount multiplication/mask formulas need per-target size/latency assessment against native POPCNT and the existing fallback.
Deferred: sparse-mask count lowering requires target-specific popcount/ctz cost and zero-policy handling; no hardware intrinsic is expanded into multiplication here.
Deferred: nonzero narrow CLZ promotion belongs in target legalization; target-independent logic does not add shifts/casts around scans.
Implemented limited: closed mask-extract/update/reinsert DAGs synthesize shorter AND/OR/XOR forms, including complementary literal masks. Arbitrary externally shared graphs refuse.
Deferred: sign-conditioned logical shifts emulate AShr, but recovering that requires select, signed comparison and shared-count proofs.
Deferred: replacing a scan loop by total CTZ needs loop-exit/PHI/zero-case reasoning; no loop or memory transformations are added.
Deferred: low-bit multiply versus CTZ/shift is target-cost sensitive and needs an explicit zero policy. Do not introduce a scan on software-scan targets.
Deferred: the example needs a relational nonzero-mask fact across a branch/call. No new closure is claimed for the preexisting facts pass.
Deferred: cross-width right shifts and casts need a count-range proof for both widths plus sign-extension preservation.
Deferred: 15-x to xor needs x<=15 or LLVM nuw. Generic wrapping subtraction is not the same identity; target instruction-selection costs also matter.
Deferred: total narrow leading-ones promotion and BSR/LZCNT speculation differ by target and zero policy; preserve the current count lowering.
Deferred: Unicode range coalescing through XOR/subtract is not uniformly profitable (discussion identifies AArch64 conditional compare); requires a range cost model.
Deferred: simplifying the ternary sign observation needs substituting condition facts into select arms, not eager bitwise evaluation of a control-flow graph.
Deferred: shift-offset folding must prove the adjusted count cannot wrap or reach the word width; do not assume Zig intCast/LLVM nuw facts exist in LCCC.
Deferred: dropping paired divisions from comparisons requires exactness/divisibility, not just a common divisor. LCCC does not represent the reported exact flag.
